caption: MCP Tool Use Content
description: A request from the assistant to call a tool. Generated from the pinned MCP schema (2025-11-25 ToolUseContent; 2026-07-28 ToolUseContent).
name: mcp_tool_use_content

mcp_meta.description:
MCP member `_meta`: Optional metadata about the tool use. Clients SHOULD preserve this field when
including tool uses in subsequent sampling requests to enable caching optimizations.

See [General fields: `_meta`](/specification/2025-11-25/basic/index#meta) for notes on `_meta` usage.

mcp_id_string.description:
MCP member `id` (required by the protocol): A unique identifier for this tool use.

This ID is used to match tool results to their corresponding tool uses.

mcp_input.description: MCP member `input` (required by the protocol): The arguments to pass to the tool, conforming to the tool's input schema.

mcp_name.description: MCP member `name` (required by the protocol): The name of the tool to call.

mcp_additional_members.description: Members the pinned definition does not name, exactly as reported, in source order.

mcp_nonconforming_members.description: Named members whose value does not fit the pinned definition, exactly as reported.
